KIRLOSKAR BROTHERS LIMITED 
A Kirloskar Group Company 
SEC/ F:26                                                                                           October 28, 2026 
 
BSE Limited 
Corporate Relationship Department, 
2nd Floor, New Trading Ring, 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, 
Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400 001. 
 
(BSE Scrip Code – 500241)   
National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. 
5th Floor, Exchange Plaza, 
Bandra (East), 
Mumbai - 400 051. 
 
 
(NSE Symbol - KIRLOSBROS) 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio Recording for Conference Call with Analysts / Investors on Unaudited  
Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended on September 30, 2026 
Ref: Regulation 30 & 46 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015.  
 
This is in continuation of our letter dated October 21, 2026 giving intimation of the subject 
mentioned conference call. 
 
In terms of the subject referred Regulations read with clause 15 of Para A Part A of  
Schedule III, we would like to inform you that the audio recording of the said call has been 
uploaded on the website of the Company (http://www.kirloskarpumps.com). This can be 
accessed at the following link. 
 
Link: https://www.kirloskarpumps.com/investors/analyst-con-call-audio-recording/  
 
The transcript for the said call will be shared with the Stock Exchange and will also be uploaded 
on the Company’s website in due course. 
  
You are requested to take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you,              
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For KIRLOSKAR BROTHERS LIMITED 
 
  
 
Devang Trivedi 
Company Secretary 
Encl.: As above 
Devang 
B Trivedi
Digitally signed by 
Devang B Trivedi
